en: Colorized vintage postcard showing a large spa or bath complex with white façades and a long red-tiled roof, set behind gardens and a terrace. A stone wall and steps lead up from the foreground, where a lone figure stands on the staircase. Trees and a small pavilion are in front of the main building. Printed captions in a South Slavic language identify the location and the type of building, with a handwritten date in the upper left.
